target_description: Reach Minecraft-class product quality through a sequence of verified releases: authored expedition, building expression, world variety, interaction feel, living ecology, long-term progression, finished co-op, durable performance, cohesive presentation, and onboarding/audio/accessibility.

overall_score.foundation: strong: streamed voxel world, survival, crafting, save/load, boats, fishing, controller/co-op plumbing
overall_score.current_release_slice: v1.27.2 Tidewatch Harbor Choice lets players pick a lasting Lookout or Landing plan at the claimed Harbor Signal
overall_score.remaining_gap: not Minecraft parity; a second named offshore route, broader regional destinations, full co-op productization, long-session performance profiling, and wider accessibility remain active release tracks

checklist.detail: Tidewatch Wreck provides a visible discovery → reward → return journey.
Players now choose Lookout or Landing at the Harbor Signal; the selected plan rebuilds the landmark.
Authored offshore wreck and harbor plans join existing BVI cove/forest/rootwalk routes; a second named destination remains.
Shared F/Circle harbor cycling, HUD plan copy, and notifications provide clearer construction feedback.
The wreck includes low-cost animated seabirds, complementing existing reef and shore life.
Discovery Log plus a persistent harbor plan give a durable return reason after Tidewatch.
P1 and P2 share the harbor plan handler; complete shared harbor roles and controller hardware proof remain.
Harbor prop remains bounded and disposal-owned; long-session browser measurement remains required.
Lookout spyglass/table and Landing pier/mooring distinguish the chosen plan on the existing signal.
Original discovery stinger and actionable early route copy complement existing responsive/accessible menu work.
